canonical_name: Khinchin's weak law of large numbers
canonical_statement: For an independent identically distributed sequence of real-valued random variables with finite first absolute moment, the arithmetic means converge in probability to their common expectation.
domain_and_universes: A measurable probability space Omega and a sequence X : Nat -> Omega -> Real; Prop
hypotheses: the family X is pairwise independent under mu
each X i has the same distribution as X 0 under mu
conclusion: (1/n) times the sum of X i for i < n converges in probability (TendstoInMeasure) to the constant integral of X 0
